title: 第六百一十三章 远古光明神的馈赠第六百一十二章 星空大神庙远古光明神
lines: 一种极其熟悉的感觉蓦然浮上心头。
吴辉不知道这种感觉究竟来自于哪里，只觉得这神像哪哪都很熟悉，不管是衣服的形状质地，还是轮廓气质，都有种莫名的熟悉感，可他明明没有见过这个神像。
这让他一时有些恍惚。
这时候。
他灵魂深处的神格忽然颤抖了一下。
一股仿佛灵魂相连的感觉蓦然出现在他的意识之中，让他一下从恍惚中惊醒。
冥冥中，似乎有什么东西融入了他的神格之中。
这一瞬间，他看到了浩渺的星空，看到了辉煌的神宫，看到了灿烂的文明，也看到了破灭和浩劫……
吴辉瞬间反应了过来。
是记忆！
这尊神像之中有远古光明神的烙印，里面应该是保存了一部分远古光明神的记忆。就在刚才，他意识中那枚继承自远古光明神的神格，吸收了这部分记忆。
虽然还没来得及详细翻阅，但这些记忆应该跟远古时期有关，或许还跟当初的远古光明神陨落之谜有关。
刚才那股玄之又玄的熟悉感，或许也是传承带来的。
吴辉几乎是迫不及待想要查看记忆，可惜，现在时机不对，他只能暂时按捺下了心头的冲动。
就这么一会儿的功夫，弩雅大长老已经带着三人来到了神像脚下，带头参拜起了远古光明神。
这么多年，弩雅大长老作为星空巨人一族的最强者，负责驻守祖地，守护英魂，同时也兼职星空大神庙的大司祭。
在她的主持下，巨人女王伊尔古丽，吴辉，查理三人很快就参拜完了神像，并在神像下做了祈祷。

“今天是酷瓦第一次来大神庙，我特意为他准备了受洗仪式。”拜完神像，弩雅大长老便道，“东西我已经备好了。你们在这里稍等一会，我这就去取来。”
说罢，她就离开去取东西了。
“受洗仪式？”
吴辉却愣住了。
他还以为参拜完就结束了，没想到居然还有这一节。
查理以为他是不理解，便解释了一句：“受洗仪式是成为信徒的第一步。举行完仪式，你才算是父神的正式信徒。”
这个吴辉当然知道。
作为光明神，没有人比他更清楚受洗仪式的重要性了。可问题是……
“那个，远古光明神不是已经陨落了吗？”吴辉不解地问道。
“那是你对父神的威能缺乏了解。”听到这话，查理瞥了他一眼，眼神中充满了看待无知之人的“悲悯”。
吴辉虚心求教：“那，你给我说说？”
“好。既然你诚心求教，我就给你说说。”查理手扶刀柄，一脸自得，以一种近乎吟诵的语调给他解释道，“父神是不死不灭的。祂没有固定的形态，也不会陨落，如今只不过是以某种我们不了解的方式，存在于宇宙虚空之中罢了。等时机一至，祂就会复苏，带领我们星空巨人一族重归顶级文明之列。”
吴辉都听愣了。
这这这……这不是自欺欺人吗？要是远古光明神没有陨落，那他的神格是哪来的？
不，不对。
重点不是这个，重点是，查理究竟是哪来的这么强烈的信心？他明明都没有见过远古光明神。
而且，不止查理是这么个论调，就连走在前面的巨人女王伊尔古丽听到这番话，也很是赞同地点了点头。
吴辉看的是一头冷汗。
这些人是都被洗脑了吗？远古光明神都陨落这么多年了，洗脑能力居然还这么强，可怕~可怕~
说话的功夫，弩雅大长老就带着准备好的仪式用具回来了。
那是一个不算特别大的青铜盆，直径大约有一百三四十米，表面还有着精美的浮雕和文字符号，从里到外都透着股不符合星空巨人审美的精细和华美。
吴辉诧异地看着那个青铜盆：“这个盆，难道是从远古时代一直传承到现在的？”
content_en:
…
An extremely familiar feeling suddenly came to mind.
Wu Hui didn't know where this feeling came from. He just felt that everything about this statue was familiar. Whether it was the shape, texture, or silhouette of the clothes, there was an inexplicable sense of familiarity, but he had clearly never seen this statue before.
This made him feel dazed for a moment.
This time.
The godhead deep in his soul suddenly trembled.
A feeling like soul connection suddenly appeared in his consciousness, waking him up from his trance.
Somehow, there seemed to be something integrated into his godhead.
At this moment, he saw the vast starry sky, the glorious palace, the splendid civilization, and also the destruction and catastrophe...
Wu Hui reacted instantly.
It's memory!
This statue has the imprint of the ancient God of Light, and it should contain part of the memory of the ancient God of Light. Just now, the godhead inherited from the ancient God of Light in his consciousness absorbed this part of the memory.
Although I haven't had time to read it in detail yet, these memories should be related to the ancient times, and perhaps also related to the mystery of the ancient God of Light's fall.
The mysterious and mysterious feeling of familiarity just now may also be brought about by inheritance.
Wu Hui almost couldn't wait to check the memory. Unfortunately, the time was not right now, so he could only temporarily suppress the impulse in his heart.
In just a short time, Elder Nuya had led three people to the foot of the statue and took the lead in worshiping the ancient God of Light.
For so many years, Great Elder Nuya, as the strongest member of the starry sky giant clan, was responsible for guarding the ancestral land and protecting the heroic souls. He also worked part-time as the high priest of the Starry Sky Great Temple.
Under her auspices, Giant Queen Ilguli, Wu Hui, and Charlie quickly paid homage to the statue and prayed under the statue.

"Today is the first time Kuwa has come to the Great Temple. I have specially prepared a baptism ceremony for him." After worshiping the statue, Elder Nuya said, "I have prepared the things. You guys wait here for a while, and I will get them right away."
After that, she left to get her things.
"Baptism ceremony?"
Wu Hui was stunned.
He thought it would be over after paying homage, but he didn't expect that there would be this section.
Charlie thought he didn't understand, so he explained: "The baptism ceremony is the first step to becoming a believer. After the ceremony, you are considered a formal believer of God the Father."
Of course Wu Hui knows this.
As the God of Light, no one knows the importance of the baptism ceremony better than him. But the problem is...
"Um, hasn't the ancient God of Light fallen?" Wu Hui asked in confusion.
"That's because you lack understanding of the power of God the Father." After hearing this, Charlie glanced at him, his eyes full of "compassion" for ignorant people.
Wu Hui humbly asked for advice: "Then, can you tell me?"
"Okay. Since you sincerely ask for advice, I will tell you." Charlie held the handle of the knife with a complacent look on his face and explained to him in a tone that was almost chanting, "God the Father is immortal. He has no fixed form and will not fall. He just exists in the void of the universe in some way that we don't understand. When the time comes, He will revive and lead our starry sky giant family back to the top civilization."
Wu Hui was stunned.
This, this, this... isn't this self-deception? If the ancient God of Light had not died, where did his godhead come from?
No, that's not right.
The point is not this, the point is, where did Charlie get such strong confidence? He has obviously never seen the ancient God of Light.
Moreover, not only Charlie had such an argument, but even the giant queen Ilgul who was walking in front nodded in agreement when she heard these words.
Wu Hui looked in a cold sweat.
Have these people been brainwashed? It’s been so many years since the ancient God of Light fell, but his brainwashing ability is still so strong. It’s scary~terrifying~
As he was talking, Elder Nuya came back with the prepared ritual tools.
It was a not particularly large bronze basin, with a diameter of about 130 to 40 meters. There were exquisite relief carvings and text symbols on the surface. From the inside to the outside, it exuded a delicacy and splendor that did not conform to the aesthetics of the starry sky giant.
Wu Hui looked at the bronze basin in surprise: "Could this basin have been passed down from ancient times to the present?"
title_en: Chapter 613: The Gift of the Ancient God of Light Chapter 612: The Ancient God of Light in the Starry Sky Temple
